messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Cousin ki shaadi ka venue final karna hai, Jaipur mein koi accha jagah batao.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Jaipur mein Rambagh wala lawn bahut chalta hai, lekin February mein wahan booking mushkil hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Budget kam hai, Rambagh mehnga lagta hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Phir Chomu Palace dekh lo, Nandini ne wahan shaadi ki thi, per plate sava sau thi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Achha, main Nandini se number maang leti hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, aur unka deposit sirf pacchas hazaar hai, wapas bhi mil jata hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Kal India ka match hai, tum dekh rahe ho?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, Australia ke saath series hai, Kohli form mein wapas aa gaya hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Score kya tha pichle match ka?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Pichle match mein India ne teen sau baais banaye aur pandrah run se jeeta.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Wah, best bowler kaun tha?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Bumrah ne aakhri over mein do wicket liye, match palat gaya.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Waise venue ka kya hua, Chomu Palace ka deposit confirm karna hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, maine Nandini ko message kiya, Chomu Palace ne pandrah February ki date de di.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Perfect, to venue final ho gaya, advance bhej dun?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, pacchas hazaar advance bhej do, baaki shaadi se pehle dena hai.

questions.answer_quote: unka deposit sirf pacchas hazaar hai

questions.answer_quote: pandrah run se jeeta

questions.answer_quote: Bumrah ne aakhri over mein do wicket liye

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Meri gaadi ki insurance renewal ki last date aa gayi hai, kya karun?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Policy wala mail kholo, usme renewal date likhi hogi, warna app pe login kar lo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: App pe dekha, pandrah March ko expire ho rahi hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Do din bache hain, NCB bacha lo, pichle saal koi claim nahi kiya tha.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Claim nahi kiya, IDV kam ho raha hai kya?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: IDV thoda girta hai har saal, lekin Suraksha ka package sasta tha, usse compare kar lo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Raat ko film dekhne gaye the kya?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, woh nayi film dekhi, story acchi thi par ending confusing.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Kaunsi film thi?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Woh astronaut wali film, do ghante chalis minute ki thi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Rating kitni mili usko?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Internet pe sava saat dikha raha tha, mujhe das me se aath lagi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: To wapas insurance pe aate hain, kaunsa package lena chahiye?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Suraksha ka comprehensive plan le lo, teen hazaar aath sau mein aa jayega.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Zero dep bhi add karna hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Zero dep ke saath pandrah sau extra lagega, par gaadi nayi hai to worth hai.

questions.query: NCB bachane se kya bachta hai?
questions.answer_quote: NCB bacha lo

questions.query: Policy kab expire ho rahi hai?
questions.answer_quote: pandrah March ko expire ho rahi hai

questions.query: Woh film kitni lambi thi?
questions.answer_quote: do ghante chalis minute ki thi

questions.query: Us picture ki public rating acchi thi?
questions.answer_quote: Internet pe sava saat dikha raha tha

questions.query: Aakhir kaunsa plan select hua?
questions.answer_quote: Suraksha ka comprehensive plan le lo

questions.query: Zero dep ke liye kitna extra dena padega?
questions.answer_quote: pandrah sau extra lagega

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tax filing ka last date paas aa gaya, documents kaunse chahiye?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Form 16 pehle nikal lo, usme salary aur TDS sab likha hota hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Form 16 mil gaya, par 80C mein kya daal sakti hoon?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: LIC premium, PPF aur ELSS sab isme aate hain, dedh lakh ki chhoot mil jati hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Meri LIC premium pandrah hazaar hai, to poori chhoot milegi?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, pandrah hazaar tak cover ho jata hai, tu bachat kar rahi hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Achha, tum subah gym ja rahe ho kya?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, paanch baje uthta hoon, phir aadhe ghante ka run lagata hoon.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Itni subah kaise uth jate ho?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Raat ko jaldi so jata hoon, das baje phone band kar deta hoon.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Diet bhi follow kar rahe ho?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Protein shake subah, aur dopahar mein sirf sabzi roti, cheeni band kar di.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Khair, tax pe wapas aate hain, ELSS mein kitna daalna chahiye?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: ELSS mein pandrah hazaar daal do, teen saal ka lock in hota hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aur PPF ka kya, purana account hai mera.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: PPF mein bhi pandrah hazaar daal do, dono mila kar chhoot poori ho jayegi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Achha, kal documents bank le jaun?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, Form 16 aur LIC receipt saath rakhna, warna objection lag jata hai.

questions.query: Salary aur TDS ka pura hisaab kahan milta hai?
questions.answer_quote: usme salary aur TDS sab likha hota hai

questions.query: Woh subah kitne baje uthta hai?
questions.answer_quote: paanch baje uthta hoon

questions.query: Cheeni band karne se kya fayda hua?
questions.answer_quote: cheeni band kar di

questions.query: ELSS mein kitna paisa daalna hai?
questions.answer_quote: ELSS mein pandrah hazaar daal do

questions.query: Bank wale kaunsi cheez maang sakte hain?
questions.answer_quote: Form 16 aur LIC receipt saath rakhna

questions.query: 80C mein kaun kaun se option aate hain?
questions.answer_quote: LIC premium, PPF aur ELSS sab isme aate hain

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Nayi flat ka agreement banwana hai, notice period kitna rakhein?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Do mahine ka notice period normal hai Bengaluru mein, usse kam mat rakho.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Landlord ek mahina bol raha hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ek mahina uske favour mein hai, do mahine likhwao warna nikalte waqt phas jaogi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Security deposit kitna dena padta hai wahan?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Usually das mahine ka rent, par Bengaluru mein thoda kam bhi chalta hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Achha, mera phone gir gaya tha, screen pe crack aa gaya.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Original display mehnga hota hai, local shop mein aadhe daam mein mil jata hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Warranty pe asar padega kya?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Warranty khatam ho jayegi, agar original part nahi lagwaya to.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: To original hi lagwaun kya?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, phone naya hai to original screen hi sahi hai, chaar hazaar lagenge.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Anyway, wapas agreement pe aate hain, deposit kitna likhna hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Deposit das mahine ka rent likhwao, aur agreement do saal ka banwao.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Registration kahan karani hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Society ke office mein hi registration ho jata hai, stamp duty alag lagti hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Stamp duty kitni hogi?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Rent ke hisaab se hoti hai, das hazaar rent pe lagbhag paanch sau rupaye.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Achha, kal landlord se milne ja rahi hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Do mahine notice period wali baat likhwa lena, warna baad mein jhagda hota hai.

questions.query: Notice period kitna rakhna chahiye?
questions.answer_quote: Do mahine ka notice period normal hai

questions.answer_quote: local shop mein aadhe daam mein mil jata hai

questions.answer_quote: Warranty khatam ho jayegi

questions.answer_quote: Deposit das mahine ka rent likhwao

questions.answer_quote: Ek mahina uske favour mein hai
